HEATING INSTRUCTIONS OVEN HEAT 200°C/392°F / Fan 180°C/Gas 6/25 Mins Remove sleeve and pierce film lid several times. Place container onto a baking tray and heat in the centre of a preheated oven. Take care when removing film lid as hot steam will escape. Check product is piping hot before serving. Do not reheat. We have given you these heating instructions as a guide only.
